sn45.7:2.1: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘the removal of lust, the removal of hatred, the removal of delusion.’
sn45.7:2.2: Of what now, venerable sir, is this the designation?”
sn45.7:2.4: “This, bhikkhu, is a designation for the element of Nibbāna:
sn45.7:2.5: the removal of lust, the removal of hatred, the removal of delusion.
sn45.7:2.6: The destruction of the taints is spoken of in that way.”
sn45.7:3.1: When this was said, that bhikkhu said to the Blessed One:
sn45.7:3.2: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘the Deathless, the Deathless.’
sn45.7:3.3: What now, venerable sir, is the Deathless? What is the path leading to the Deathless?”
sn45.7:3.4: “The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion:
